description: This data set holds twelve future scenarios for 2020 to 2050 run with GCAM-USA, the version of the Global Change Analysis Model with state-level detail for the United States, for the GODEEEP project (Grid Operations, Decarbonization, Environmental and Energy Equity Platform). It was produced to study how climate, socioeconomic and technology change, current decarbonisation incentives and longer-term policies affect the US energy economy, the electricity grid, well-being and the environment. Scenarios cover business as usual and net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, all net-zero cases with a carbon-free electricity system by 2035, crossed with climate impacts, incentives and carbon capture availability. Coverage is the 50 states and the District of Columbia within 32 world regions, for 2020 to 2050. Outputs are GCAM XML databases in ZIP files of about 0.8 to 1 GB each, readable with the GCAM Model Interface, gcamreader or gcamextractor, on Zenodo (version 3.0.2, updated July 2024) under CC0-1.0 at no cost; version 2.0.0 also ships the GCAM-USA source used. Caveats: these are model projections under stated assumptions, not observations. Simulation uses are energy system and grid capacity planning and climate impact studies. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
